sn36.19:1.1: Atha kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati yenāyasmā Udāyī tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Udāyim abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantam Udāyim etad avoca || ||
sn36.19:1.2: Kati nu kho bhante Udāyi vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn36.19:1.3: Tisso kho thapati vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā
sn36.19:1.4: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.19:1.5: imā kho thapati vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ti || || 4
sn36.19:1.6: Evaṃ vutte Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantam Udāyim etad avoca ||
sn36.19:1.7: Na kho bhante Udāyī tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ||
sn36.19:1.10: yāyam bhante adukkhamasukhā vedanā santasmim esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā Bhagavatā ti || || 5
sn36.19:2.1: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Udāyī Pañcakaṅgam thapatim etad avoca ||
sn36.19:2.2: Na kho thapati dve vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ||
sn36.19:2.4: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.19:2.5: imā tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn36.19:2.6: Dutiyam pi kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantam Udāyim etad avoca ||
sn36.19:2.7: Na kho bhante Udāyi tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ||
sn36.19:2.10: yāyam bhante adukkhamasukhā vedanā santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā Bhagavatā ti || || 6
sn36.19:3.1: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Udāyī Pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatim etad avoca ||
sn36.19:3.2: Na kho thapati dve vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ||
sn36.19:3.4: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.19:3.5: imā tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn36.19:3.6: Tatiyam pi kho Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantam Udāyim etad avoca
sn36.19:3.7: Na kho bhante Udāyi tisso vedanā vuttā Bhagavatā ||
sn36.19:3.10: yāyam bhante adukkhamasukhā vedanā santasmiṃ esā paṇīte sukhe vuttā Bhagavatā ti || ||
sn36.19:3.11: Neva kho asakkhi āyasmā Udāyī Pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatim saññāpetuṃ || na panāsakkhi Pañcakaṅgo thapati āyasmantam Udāyiṃ saññāpetuṃ || || 7
sn36.19:3.12: Assosi kho āyasmā Ānando āyasmato Udāyissa Pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhim imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ || || 8
sn36.19:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || ||
sn36.19:4.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando yāvatako āyasmato Udāyissa Pañcakaṅgena thapatinā saddhim ahosi kathāsallāpo tam pi sabbam Bhagavato ārocesi || || 9
sn36.19:5.1: Santam eva kho Ānanda pariyāyaṃ Pañcakaṅgo thapati Udāyissa bhikkhuno nābbhanumodi ||
sn36.19:5.2: santaṃ ca panānanda pariyāyam Udāyī bhikkhu Pañcakaṅgassa thapatino nābbhanumodi || ||
sn36.19:5.3: Dve pi mayā Ānanda vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.4: tisso pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.5: pañca pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.6: cha pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.7: aṭṭharasā pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.8: chattiṃsā pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.9: aṭṭhasatam pi mayā vedanā vuttā pariyāyena ||
sn36.19:5.11: Evam pariyāyadesite kho Ānanda mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ na samanumaññissanti na samanujānissanti na samanumodissanti || tesam etam pāṭikaṅkham bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivādāpannā aññamaññam mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharissanti || ||
sn36.19:5.13: evam pariyāyadesite kho Ānanda mayā dhamme ye aññamaññassa subhāsitaṃ sulapitaṃ samanumaññissanti samanujānissanti samanumodissanti || tesam etam pāṭikaṅkhaṃ samaggā sammodamānā avivadamānā khīrodakībhūtā aññamaññam piyacakkhūhi sampassantā viharissanti || || 11
sn36.19:6.3: Cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā pīyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīya || la ||
sn36.19:6.4: Kāyaviññeyyā poṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn36.19:6.6: Yaṃ kho Ānanda ime pañca kāmaguṇe paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ ||
sn36.19:6.9: Etam paramaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentī ti ||
sn36.19:6.12: Atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantatarañca paṇītatarañca ||
sn36.19:7.1: kataṃ cānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītatarañca || ||
sn36.19:7.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:7.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || || 13
sn36.19:7.5: Etam paramaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentīti ||
sn36.19:7.8: Atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītatarañca ||
sn36.19:8.1: katamañcānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca panītataraṃ ca || ||
sn36.19:8.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvam avitakkam avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukham dutiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:8.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || || 14
sn36.19:8.5: Etam paramaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentī ti ||
sn36.19:8.8: atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca ||
sn36.19:9.1: katamaṃ cānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || ||
sn36.19:9.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhaṃ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti || yantam ariyā ācikkhanti upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti || tatiyaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:9.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññam sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || 15
sn36.19:9.5: Etam paramaṃ sattā sukham somanassam paṭisaṃvedetīti ||
sn36.19:9.8: atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataram ca paṇītataraṃ ca ||
sn36.19:10.1: katamañ cānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataran ca || ||
sn36.19:10.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānam atthagamā adukkhamasukham upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:10.3: idam Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || || 16
sn36.19:10.5: Etam paramaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentīti
sn36.19:10.8: atthānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca ||
sn36.19:11.1: katamaṃ cānanda etamhā sukhā aññam sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || ||
sn36.19:11.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānam atthagamā nānattasaññānam amanasikarā Anatto ākāso ti ākāsānañcāyatanam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:11.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā || pe || || 17
sn36.19:11.4: Ye ca kho Ānanda evaṃ vadeyyuṃ ||
sn36.19:11.5: Etaṃ paramaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentīti ||
sn36.19:12.1: katamañ cānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukhaṃ || pe ||
sn36.19:12.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Anattam viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:12.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā || pe || || 18
sn36.19:12.5: Etam paramam sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentīti ||
sn36.19:12.8: atthānanda etamhā sukhā || pe || katamaṃ cānanda
sn36.19:13.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma Natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanam upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:13.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītatarañca || || 19
sn36.19:13.5: Etam paramaṃ sattā sukhaṃ somanassam paṭisaṃvedentīti ||

sn36.19:14.1: etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || ||

sn36.19:14.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇitataraṃ ca || || 20

sn36.19:15.1: cānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇītataraṃ ca || ||
sn36.19:15.2: Idhānanda bhikkhu sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodham upasampajja viharati ||
sn36.19:15.3: idaṃ kho Ānanda etamhā sukhā aññaṃ sukham abhikkantataraṃ ca paṇitataraṃ ca || || 21
sn36.19:16.1: Ṭhānaṃ kho panetam Ānanda vijjati yam aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ vadeyyuṃ ||
sn36.19:16.2: Saññāvedayitanirodham Samaṇo Gotamo āha || taṃ ca sukhasmim paññāpeti
sn36.19:16.4: Evaṃ vādino Ānanda aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam assu vacanīyā ||
sn36.19:16.5: Na kho āvuso Bhagavā sukhaññeva vedanaṃ sandhāya sukhasmim paññāpeti ||
sn36.19:16.6: yattha yatthāvuso sukham upalabbhati || yaṃhi yaṃhi sukhaṃ taṃ taṃ tathāgato sukhasmim paññāpetīti || || 3
